chunks.title: About Hari
chunks.content: Hari Kurniawan is a Software Engineer specializing in frontend and full-stack development, with 5+ years of experience building web and mobile applications. He has worked on internal platforms and business applications, developing reusable interfaces, integrating REST APIs, building micro-frontend modules, and supporting production applications. He has taken on frontend leadership responsibilities including technical guidance, mentoring, and code reviews. He is also developing applied AI engineering skills through

He is also developing applied AI engineering skills through an independent AI Portfolio Assistant project using Python, FastAPI, Groq-hosted LLMs, RAG, embeddings, FAISS, hybrid search, and multi-document retrieval. He holds a Bachelor degree in Informatics Engineering from Universitas Komputer Indonesia (UNIKOM), 2017–2021.

chunks.title: AI Portfolio Assistant — Personal AI Engineering Project
chunks.content: Independent hands-on AI engineering project, ongoing in 2026. Hari built an interactive portfolio assistant with a React frontend and Python FastAPI backend, connected to Groq-hosted LLMs. The retrieval pipeline uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Sentence Transformers multilingual embeddings, FAISS vector indexing, hybrid keyword and semantic search, and document ingestion for structured JSON knowledge and multiple PDF documents. PDF processing uses PyMuPDF for text extraction, chunking, source metadata

The assistant retrieves relevant passages and supplies context to the LLM to generate answers grounded in portfolio information. This is a personal learning and portfolio project, not a paid AI Engineer job at an employer. chunks.title: Personal Background — Hari Kurniawan
chunks.content: Nama lengkap Hari Kurniawan. Hari berasal dari Tasikmalaya dan saat ini berdomisili di Mampang Prapatan, Jakarta. Tanggal lahir 6 Oktober 1997 (umur 29 tahun per November 2026). Bahasa yang digunakan: Indonesia, Inggris, dan Malaysia. Hobi Hari adalah bermain game PC competitive, terutama Dota 2, Valorant, dan PUBG di Steam. Hari menggambarkan dirinya sebagai pribadi analitis, adaptif, bertanggung jawab, memiliki rasa ingin tahu tinggi, senang mempelajari hal baru, terbuka terhadap masukan, mampu bekerja mandiri

chunks.content: Hari termotivasi untuk terus mengembangkan kemampuan dan memperluas pengalaman profesional, khususnya di bidang teknologi dan software engineering.
